purpose: Every capability worker is either named by a transport route or listed here with a reason. Twice in this session a worker existed with no route pointing at it, which made a present capability look missing; this record is how that stays visible instead of recurring.

unrouted.reason: it takes an output directory plus frame interval and frame cap options, and the route contract has no place for either yet: the artifact-root mechanism exists, but parameters are currently required to be empty, so routing it would need a deliberate contract change rather than a flag. Unrouted on purpose and recorded here.
unrouted.what_it_would_serve: F11 (MP4/MOV/MKV/WebM): frame events and sampling coverage

also_present_but_not_capability_workers.note: takes a URL and an output directory and fetches the page; it is a fetch client, not an extraction capability, and no route may reach the network. F03 (dynamic and long pages) therefore has no fetch path at all: only a saved snapshot can be read, and pagination or scroll coverage cannot be recorded without a browser.
a dispatcher with no engine identity of its own; it selects another worker rather than producing a receipt.

routed_since_this_record.note: routed on 2026-10-01. The recorded reason for leaving it unrouted was that no model was configured anywhere the repository could see; that is resolved by resolving the model through the declared capability registry, with ARCHEAXIS_ASR_MODEL_DIR and a declared-path fallback, and it was verified end to end on a real Chinese recording through the real sidecar protocol: language zh at 0.9983, 2 segments over 8,940 ms, engine python-worker-transcribe 0.1.0, covered 2 of 2. Kept here as history because the exemption was real until the model resolution and the audio media types existed.

routed in round 84 after being listed here as unrouted. It is a model call (default qwen2.5vl:7b against a local ollama), so its description is recorded as a labelled candidate rather than extracted content, and a missing model fails the job by name. It stays listed here as history: the exemption was real until the contract could carry a model-backed route.

known_duplication: services/python-workers/document/worker_media.py (routed as media.probe) probes media headers only, while services/python-workers/media/worker_video.py extracts frames and media/worker_transcribe.py transcribes. They are complementary rather than duplicates: the probe reports container facts without decoding a sample, and the two heavier engines produce a transcript and frame events respectively. As of 2026-10-01 the transcribe engine is routed and the video engine is still awaiting a contract that can carry its parameters.
